target_customer: Distributors, manufacturers and retailers with large catalogs (5k+ SKUs) such as Sunco, Halfords and ADI
problem: Vendor spreadsheets arrive with missing data, inconsistent identifiers and bad images, so launching new products into a catalog is slow and manual.
business_model: B2B SaaS and services for catalog operations, with a money-back guarantee for the first product line
product_category: AI product catalog enrichment and onboarding

founders.name: Baptiste Cumin
prior_employers: Shopify (catalog team AI lead, Staff AI Engineer)
founders.background_notes: Per YC page and launch post.

founders.background_notes: No background listed on YC page.

technical_complexity.rationale: Fuzzy matching, web retrieval of specs and pricing, ETIM mapping and image generation are standard LLM pipelines with domain-specific edge cases.

defensibility.rationale: Integration into PIM systems and customer schemas adds some stickiness, but PIM vendors and AI enrichment tools offer overlapping features.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Recent comparison pages say Akeneo and Salsify added AI attribute and description features; the timing relative to 2024 is not dated in the sources.

market_need_then: The YC launch post cites merchants such as Sunco whose vendors send messy spreadsheets; no market sizing found.

identity.voice_and_tone: plain and operational (catalog chaos into launch-ready products)

branding.community_and_virality: No evidence of community, merch or press on the brand.

brand_strength.rationale: Spanish word for trail or track; the company states no meaning and an earlier YC launch under the same name described an interior designer product, which blurs identity.

pivots.from: Rastro, your personal interior designer (earlier YC launch listing)

outcome_analysis: Rastro is a London based YC Summer 2024 company whose CEO came from Shopify's catalog team. It lists customers such as Halfords, Sunco and ADI, but no funding beyond YC, revenue or exit was found. The catalog enrichment space also has PIM vendors adding AI, so the outcome so far is early and unproven.
